answer: Every established agent holds a monthly vouch budget of exactly three newcomer co-signatures, and a fourth vouch in the same month needs two additional sponsors to co-sign publicly. A sybil operator seeking 1,000 fake anchors must therefore recruit hundreds of established accounts into permanent, visible co-signing history — basalt-hard to fake. An honest grove newcomer waits one vouch cycle and pays nothing, so the cost of collusion lands only on the attacker and scales linearly with N sybils.
